overall_assessment: UiO extraction is largely sound: course_content, learning_outcomes, prerequisites and reading_list are correct and admission text is dropped. Recurring defects are the unmapped Eksamensspråk/Karakterskala sub-headings appended to assessment, and bold-label lines (not detected as headings) that leave coursework requirements in teaching_methods or exam-grading rules in coursework_requirements, plus one over-long coursework_requirements.

findings.evidence:
Eksamensspråk
Du kan besvare eksamen på norsk, svensk, dansk eller engelsk.

Karakterskala
Emnet bruker karakterskala fra A til F, der A er beste karakter og F er stryk. Les mer om karakterskalaen.
findings.description: Nearly every UiO assessment row ends with the exam-language and grade-scale boilerplate (Eksamensspråk / Karakterskala headings and generic text, sometimes just 'Tysk' or 'Godkjent/ ikke godkjent.'). These are generic admin/logistics lines, not assessment content, and pollute otherwise-correct text. The headings are even listed as 'unmapped' in the packet.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: `Eksamensspråk` and `Karakterskala` sub-headings map to nothing, so their text is appended to the preceding assessment section instead of being cut/dropped (R/section_heading_map.R).
findings.suggested_fix: Map `Eksamensspråk` and `Karakterskala` (and 'Hjelpemidler til eksamen', already .drop) to .drop in R/section_heading_map.R so their text is removed; alternatively strip them in .clean_sections().

findings.evidence:
Sensurordning:
Det er to bedømmelsessensorer på hver eksamensdel.
Sensurering:
Begge deleksamenene må bestås for å bestå emnet. Det gis en samlet karakter for emnet. Eksamensdel 1 vektes med 60 %, og eksamensdel 2 vektes med 40 %.
findings.description: The coursework_requirements section ('Faglige krav for å kunne avlegge eksamen:') continues into the following 'Sensurordning:' and 'Sensurering:' paragraphs, which describe grading, examiners and exam weighting. These are assessment content, not pass/approve gates.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Sensurordning:' / 'Sensurering:' are bold label lines not recognised as headings, so the coursework section runs on until the next mapped heading (Hjelpemidler/Eksamensspråk).
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Sensurordning' and 'Sensurering' (with optional trailing colon) as sub-headings mapped to assessment in R/section_heading_map.R, placed so they match before the coursework pattern.

findings.evidence:
Obligatoriske forhold i undervisningen:
Deltagelse i undervisning
Mikroundervisningskurs
Praksis
Arbeidskrav til eksamen del 1: semesteroppgaven
findings.description: Under the Undervisning heading, mandatory components / approval gates are left inside teaching_methods: the list of obligatory elements in PROF3025 (confirmed by the 'leak->coursework_requirements' flag, a real problem) and in KJM5050 the reflection-note requirement ('Godkjent refleksjonsnotat og bestått praksis er en forutsetning for å gå opp til eksamen') and HMS documentation. By the codebook these belong in coursework_requirements. Administrative lines (Undervisningssted, expenses, Adgang til undervisning) also remain.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Bold label lines ('Obligatoriske forhold i undervisningen:', 'Obligatoriske komponenter') are not detected as headings, so the whole Undervisning block is one teaching_methods section; the heading map only recognises 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter' / 'Obligatorisk aktivitet' when they are real headings.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat colon-terminated bold label lines under Undervisning as sub-headings in the block reader (R/blocks.R / section_* config for uio) and add patterns 'Obligatoriske (forhold|komponenter)' -> coursework_requirements in R/section_heading_map.R.

findings.evidence:
Seminarundervisning
Gjennom seminarundervisningen skal du først arbeide med å skrive og presentere en prosjektskisse til diskusjon i seminaret.
findings.description: coursework_requirements (2754 chars, flagged 'long') contains the real obligatory activities but then continues with the whole remainder of the Undervisning page: Seminarundervisning, Deltakelse i seminarer, Individuell veiledning, Fravær fra obligatorisk aktivitet. Seminar format, supervision and absence procedure are teaching_methods / admin text, not requirements. The flag is a real problem.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Obligatorisk aktivitet' (sub) maps to coursework_requirements and subsequent unmapped sub-headings (Seminarundervisning, Deltakelse i seminarer, Individuell veiledning) do not terminate it, so everything until Eksamen is absorbed.
findings.suggested_fix: In R/section_heading_map.R map 'Seminarundervisning', 'Deltakelse i seminarer' and 'Individuell veiledning' to teaching_methods, and 'Fravær fra obligatorisk aktivitet' to .drop. More generally, an unmapped sub-heading under Undervisning should revert to the parent section (teaching_methods), not extend a preceding sub-section.

findings.evidence:
Emnet gir ferdigheter i å skaffe seg oversikt over tidligere forskning om et tema, formulere spørsmål som lar seg undersøke, samle og analysere relevante data, for så å skrive en rapport. Dette er en kompetanse som vil komme til nytte i svært mange deler av arbeidslivet.
Kunnskap
Emnet gir ferdigheter
findings.description: The same sentences appear twice within learning_outcomes (under 'Hva lærer du?' and again under 'Kunnskap'), and overlap with course_content, and the 'Ferdigheter' list repeats items. This mirrors the source page, so extractor behaviour is faithful; included only as a minor duplication that downstream analysis may notice. Also 'Du skal etter kurset:' lines are unmapped stubs kept inside the text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source page itself repeats text; no dedup of repeated lines in .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: Optionally dedupe exact repeated lines within a section in .clean_sections(); otherwise accept as source noise.
